opportunities.title: auth refresh endpoint issues tokens without verifying the requester
opportunities.summary: ## Bug `POST /api/auth/refresh` currently issues a fresh access token without checking the requester at all. The service also signs that token for the hard-coded subject `usr_existing` with role `client`, so even an authenticated caller does not get a token for their own subject and role. ## Expected fix Protect the refresh route with the existing bearer-token auth middleware, pass the verified user payload into the refresh service, and sign the refreshed token for that authenticated subject and role. Add route-level tests for unauthenticated rejection and authenticated subject preservation. ## Scope This issue is limited to the auth refresh route/service behavior for `/api/auth/refresh` and focused API tests. This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #743 for more information. References #743.

opportunities.summary: **Context** `hexToBytes` in `lib/stellar/scval.ts` (lines 103-113) parses each two-character chunk with `parseInt(chunk, 16)` and assigns the result directly into a `Uint8Array`. Because `parseInt("gg", 16)` returns `NaN` and `Uint8Array` coerces `NaN` to `0`, malformed input such as `hexToBytes("gggg")` or `hexToBytes("0xzz")` silently produces zero bytes instead of throwing. Its only caller is `bytes32ToScVal` (lines 24-32), which then happily builds a `BytesN<32>` scval from those zero bytes as if they were a valid 32-byte order hash, defeating the strict "must be exactly 32 bytes" guard documented above it. opportunities.title: [Bounty: $45] Fix CartProvider hydration race that drops items added before the mount effect runs
opportunities.summary: **Context** CartProvider hydrates from localStorage in a useEffect after mount (context/CartContext.jsx:13-21) while cartItems starts as [] (line 9). addToCart (24-40) appends to the in-memory array and writes it straight back to localStorage, so an add that lands before the hydration effect executes reads prevCartItems=[] and overwrites the stored snapshot with only the new product; the hydration effect then reads that overwritten value and the previously stored cart is lost. Consumers on app/shop/page.jsx can fire Add before the passive effect runs after a hard load. **Proposed Change** Gate writes behind hydration (e.g. a hydrated flag set in the effect) or read the localStorage snapshot inside addToCart's updater when not yet hydrated, so pre-hydration adds merge with stored items instead of clobbering them. **Acceptance Criteria** - Adding an item before the hydration effect resolves keeps previously stored cart items plus the new one in both state and localStorage - Cart badge count and total match the merged contents after hydration - Regression test covers the pre-hydration add ordering; existing post-hydration behaviour unchanged **Suggested Label**: bug **ETA:** 24 hours
